title: Off-by-one in term index
description: Student treats the first term as term 0, or forgets that reaching the nth term takes (n - 1) steps of the common difference.
observableError: Answer is exactly one common difference too large.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Computes a1 + n*d instead of a1 + (n-1)*d.

distractorRule.summary: Use a1 + n*d instead of a1 + (n-1)*d

feedback: Count the steps of the common difference from term 1 to term n: there are (n - 1), not n.
remediationHint: List the first few terms and count the jumps.

title: Sign error on common difference
description: Student subtracts the common difference instead of adding it, or mishandles a negative common difference.
observableError: Answer reflects the wrong direction of change.
feedback: Check whether the sequence increases or decreases, and add the common difference (which may be negative).
remediationHint: Write out term 1 and term 2 to confirm the direction.

title: Forgot to multiply by the common difference
description: Student adds the number of steps but forgets to multiply by the common difference.
feedback: Each step changes the term by d, so multiply the (n - 1) steps by the common difference.
remediationHint: Each jump is of size d, not 1.

title: Omitted the one-half in the sum formula
description: Student uses n(2a1 + (n-1)d) without dividing by 2.
observableError: Sum is exactly twice the correct value.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Computes n*(2*a1 + (n-1)*d) with no division by 2.
feedback: The sum formula has a factor of one half: S_n = n/2 (2u_1 + (n-1)d).
remediationHint: Pair the first and last terms; there are n/2 such pairs.

title: Treats all terms as equal to the last term
description: Student multiplies the last term by n, ignoring that the terms vary.
observableError: Sum equals n times the nth term.

distractorRule.summary: Multiply the last term by n

feedback: The terms are not all equal; use the sum formula or pair first and last terms.
remediationHint: Add the smallest and largest terms and use the number of pairs.
